method.step4_static_data_read: Parsed the sha256-identified PE32 input's section table and read little-endian dwords directly from .data. For each VA, RVA = VA - imageBase and file offset = section raw pointer + (RVA - section RVA). This direct initialized-byte read does not rely on Ghidra's default DAT_/int typing.
method.step5_catalog_address_check: Compared 0x00010007 through 0x0001000B with the client image range and canonical symbol addresses. Every value is below the image base and no catalog symbol has any of those addresses.

findings.runtimeInitialization: No code store to 0x0130D4F8 through 0x0130D504 was found by the complete compound-aware scan; the values are statically initialized in .data.
findings.valueShape: The table contains five consecutive dword values 0x00010007 through 0x0001000B. These are enum-like integer tags, not valid pointers into the client image.
findings.fieldVerdict: BCS-S-0052 LuaClassRegistryEntry +0x08 class_kind is correctly typed uint32_t. FUN_00CE2BC0 copies tag 0x00010007 into new entries and FUN_00CE1DD0 compares that field with tags 0x00010008, 0x00010009, and 0x0001000A.
findings.globalPromotion: The five globals are anonymous cells in one contiguous class-kind table and do not have independently evidenced semantic names, so no BCS-Y rows were promoted.
